news.headline: Moon Photos for Everyone!
news.body: NASA just shared more than 11,000 pictures and videos from the Artemis II astronauts' trip around the Moon. Anyone can look at them, even kids! Scientists hope the photos will help plan the next trips to the Moon.

news.headline: Two Baby Capybaras Move to the Zoo
news.body: Two capybara siblings just moved into their new home at the San Francisco Zoo. They are only four months old, and they don't have names yet! Capybaras love to swim, and these two may be ready for visitors next week.

news.headline: A Giant Bug Makes a Big Comeback
news.body: The wētāpunga is a huge insect from New Zealand, and some weigh more than a mouse! Not long ago there were very few left. Helpers at zoos raised more than 11,000 of them and set them free on safe islands.

fun_fact: The capybara is the biggest rodent in the world. It can hold its breath underwater for about five minutes! 🌊
